text: Tameeni, Saudi Arabia's online insurance aggregator, is a flagship subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology Co., which listed 22.74 million shares (30% of its capital) on the Main Market of the Saudi Exchange in June 2024. At the IPO, MENAbytes named Saudi venture-capital firm Impact46 as Rasan's largest shareholder, with 18.65% pre-IPO diluting to 13.06% after the offering.
short: Tameeni is a flagship subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology, listed on the Saudi Exchange in June 2024; at the IPO its largest shareholder was Saudi VC firm Impact46 (13.06%).
